text: The Canadian National Exhibition Association (CNEA) commissioned in 2016 the creation of a Unity Pole for Canada's 150th birthday. During the 2017 Canadian National Exhibition Annual Fair, the Unity Pole was unveiled and on display in Heritage Court at Exhibition Place as shown on Appendix C attached. The CNEA has requested the installation of the Unity Pole at Exhibition Place and this report recommends an agreement with the CNEA on the terms and conditions of such installation.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved a four-year agreement with the Canadian National Exhibition Association for installation of the Unity Pole at Exhibition Place on the terms and conditions set out in Appendix A to the report (May 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions as approved by the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and the City Solicitor.
